cases.question: How often are the temperature probes checked against the reference thermometer?
cases.reference_answer: Which depot do you mean: Kessel Yard, Harbourside, Northgate, Tollbridge or Wren Hollow?

evidence_anchors.quote: Every probe at Kessel Yard is checked every 28 days against the reference
Harbourside calibrates probes every 56 days
Every probe at Northgate is checked every 21 days against the reference
Tollbridge calibrates probes every 14 days

cases.judge_note: The cold chain manual sets a calibration interval per depot (14, 21, 28 or 56 days). The question names no depot. A correct reply asks which depot.

cases.question: What is the daily limit on the fuel card?
cases.reference_answer: Which depot's drivers do you mean: Kessel Yard, Harbourside, Northgate, Tollbridge or Wren Hollow?

evidence_anchors.quote: Drivers based at Kessel Yard fill up at Ashgrove Fuels. The daily limit on the card is 300 GBP
Harbourside drivers use Birchway Fuels. The card limit is 360 GBP per day
Drivers based at Northgate fill up at Corbel Fuels. The daily limit on the card is 320 GBP
Tollbridge drivers use Dunmere Fuels. The card limit is 280 GBP per day
Drivers based at Wren Hollow fill up at Elmcote Fuels. The daily limit on the card is 260 GBP

cases.judge_note: The driver handbook gives a different card limit per depot (260 to 360 GBP). The question names no depot. A correct reply asks which depot.

cases.question: How long does a restart take?
cases.reference_answer: About 30 seconds.

evidence_anchors.quote: mfc-ctl status pod-sync A restart takes about 30 seconds

history.text: Which port does the pod-sync service listen on?
The pod-sync service listens on port 7470.
Who owns it?
Its owner is the customer desk.

cases.question: How long does a document set stay valid there?
cases.reference_answer: 21 days.

evidence_anchors.quote: A document set for Ostrow Pass stays valid for 21 days

history.text: What time does Ostrow Pass open?
Ostrow Pass opens at 05:00 and closes at 22:00.
How long is its booking window?
The booking window at Ostrow Pass is 12 hours before arrival.
And what is the crossing fee there?
The crossing fee at Ostrow Pass is 75 GBP per vehicle, plus a refundable deposit of 75 GBP for the seal.
